recommended_action: Close the alert as a false positive in accordance with runbook RB-0615, and apply the recommended tuning exclusion for the credentialed vulnerability scanner account svc-vulnscan on this detection rule.
summary: The alert triggered on a high volume of Kerberos service ticket requests by the authorized service account svc-vulnscan from scan-ops-01. Internal runbook RB-0615 explicitly identifies this scanner behavior as expected activity during authenticated vulnerability scanning runs, not malicious Kerberoasting, rendering the assertion false.
